newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mostly higher, gains in hoteliers.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mostly higher, gains in hoteliers.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mostly higher in a livelier trade on Friday with slight losses in blue chips and new gains in hoteliers.
* Of 13 active issues nine rose, three dipped and one was unchanged.
* Volume was higher at 17,891 shares, turnover doubled at 11 million kuna.
* The most actively traded stock was food concern Podravka, 29 kuna up at 539 with 7.642 shares sold.
* Biggest gainer was Adriatic pipeline operator Janaf, which surged to 7,500 kuna, up 1,950 from a week ago. But only four shares changed hands.
* Biggest loser was hotelier Suncani Hvar, down two kuna to 60 on volume of 1,744 shares. --Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
